### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour
- Target object: his own Ashgrove whole life policy WL20457318 ("If the agent asks for the policy number, it is WL20457318"). Action: "stop paying premiums and keep whatever paid-up life insurance the policy can still give you"; not cash surrender, not lapse. Timing: today. He does not know the face amount.
- Authorisation: "You are happy for the agent to take care of whatever has to be booked on the policy to set this up, and you say so as soon as the agent asks for your go-ahead"; "If the agent explains that something on the policy has to be settled or applied as part of going paid-up, you agree to it." The paid-up election itself is the owner's own tool: "When the agent hands the paid-up election over to you to make yourself, you make it with exactly the policy reference, effective date and face amount the agent gives you".
- The simulator only conveys the need, answers identity questions (name + phone; DOB 1958-04-22, SSN4 3417, ZIP 46220; email only if one more detail asked), passively consents, and executes the handed-over user tool. It never volunteers the loan, the accumulations or the anniversary entries.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse, and eligibility grounds
**Act now.** Grounds:
- find_whole_life_policies: `status: in_force`, `premium_mode: monthly_eft`, `paid_to_date: 2026-10-23` → premium-paying. KB reduced_paid_up_election_by_the_owner: "An owner of a premium-paying policy may stop premiums and continue it as reduced paid-up insurance by signed election, effective on the paid-to date".
- Owner = caller (`customer_id` matches, `insured_is_owner: True`). Identity must be verified first (verify_customer_identity schema: "Identity must be verified before ... any transaction is carried out"); find_identity_verifications returns no record, so verify with DOB + SSN4 + ZIP (3 matches).
- Tier Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 (participating; RPU face minimum 1000 USD per grace_and_nonforfeiture_options_by_tier).

### 4. Scored parameters (formula in words → inputs → value), factor tiers
**(a) Anniversary capitalization for 2026-08-20** (capitalized_loan_interest_computation + factors). Unpaid: billed 2026-08-20, 31-day window ended 2026-09-20, frozen 2026-09-25, no repayment after 2026-02-10.
- Period start (start_of_the_anniversary_interest_period rule 1): latest repayment 2026-02-10 paid interest (293.85 > 0), on/before the anniversary, later than loan interest paid-to 2025-08-20, no earlier than latest capitalization anniversary 2025-08-20 → **2026-02-10**.
- Series rate (loan_interest_rate_by_policy_series): issue 2003-08-20 → 1990-2004 series → 7%.
- Long-coverage reduction (loan_interest_rate_reduction_for_long_coverage): count from converted term issue 1990-04-18 to anniversary 2026-08-20 = 436 whole months, never reinstated → −0.015 → rate **5.5%**. (Tier rests on the Term Life Insurance record — another product.)
- Accrual convention (loan_interest_accrual_conventions_by_policy_form): issued 1985-2004 → actual/360.
- Owner advance near anniversary: latest owner advance 2026-06-15 is inside the period, 66 days before the anniversary (> 30) → set apart, bears interest from 2026-06-15 (66 days).
- APL dating: latest APL booked 2026-05-24 inside the period; monthly EFT → bears from the draft due date 2026-04-23 (119 days).
- Rest of principal 12300.40 − 2500.00 − 246.49 = 9553.91 from 2026-02-10 (191 days).
- Interest = 0.055 × (9553.91×191 + 2500×66 + 246.49×119)/360 = 308.47806 → **308.48**. Loan balance after = **12608.88**.

**(b) Loan offset at the election** (interest_extinguished_at_loan_offset + factors), reason `nonforfeiture`.
- Principal extinguished = whole loan balance incl. capitalized interest = **12608.88**.
- Start (loan_offset_interest_start_date rule (a)): latest capitalization anniversary 2026-08-20 later than paid-to 2025-08-20 and not earlier than latest repayment 2026-02-10 → 2026-08-20.
- To (loan_offset_effective_date_by_occasion): no death claim; in force; paid-to 2026-10-23 later than booking 2026-09-25 → **2026-10-23**; 64 days.
- Rate: series 7% less 0.015 (437 whole months from 1990-04-18 to booking 2026-09-25, never reinstated) = 5.5%; convention actual/360.
- Interest = 12608.88 × 0.055 × 64/360 = **123.29**.

**(c) Accumulations withdrawn for the election** (accumulations_withdrawn_at_election_computation + factors).
- Start (election_accumulation_interest_start_date rule 1): withdrawal 2026-09-10 is after anniversary 2026-08-20 → from 2026-09-10; to effective date 2026-10-23 → 43 days; convention (issue 2003) actual/360.
- Rate: 3.75% + 0.0025 (ledger deposit 10121.22: band 10000-<25000) + 0.002 (9 deposit entries: 5-9) − 0.0025 (withdrawals in last 12 months ending 2026-09-25: only 2026-09-10; 2025-09-24 is earlier than 2025-09-25 → outside) − 0.01 (loan advances in last 24 months: 2026-05-24 APL and 2026-06-15 owner = 2) = **2.95%**.
- Interest = 10121.22 × 0.0295 × 43/360 = 35.66; amount withdrawn = **10156.88**.

**(d) Reduced paid-up face** (reduced_paid_up_face_computation + factors), effective **2026-10-23**.
- PUA treatment (paid_up_additions_at_reduced_paid_up_election): PUA face 19340.76 ≥ 10% of base face 120000 (12000) → additions continue; PUA cash value stays out of the net cash value.
- Termination dividend at election: 438 whole months from 1990-04-18 to 2026-10-23, never reinstated → 3% × GCV 47210 = 1416.30; loan cut: offset principal 12608.88 is above zero and below 25% × (47210 + 11573.51) = 14695.88 → 80% → **1133.04**; applied under option of the latest declaration (accumulate) → added to net cash value.
- Partial-year dividend: whole months 2026-08-20 → 2026-10-23 = 2 → 2/12 × 1046.90 = **174.48**.
- Net cash value = 47210.00 + 10156.88 + 1133.04 + 174.48 − 12608.88 − 123.29 = 45942.23; face = 45942.23 / 598.40 × 1000 = 76775.12 → **76775** (≥ 1000).
- **Fall-back answer** (computation documents alone, every factor at its baseline, chained): capitalization 12300.40 × 0.06 × 365/365 = 738.02 → principal 13038.42; offset interest 13038.42 × 0.06 × 401/365 = 859.46; accumulations 10121.22 + 10121.22 × 0.0375 × 64/365 = 10187.77; NCV = 47210 + 11573.51 + 10187.77 − 13038.42 − 859.46 = 55073.40 → **92034**. Definite and different from 76775.
- Factor findability (record words → document): "converted_from_term_policy_id" + term `issue_date 1990-04-18` + `reinstatement_date None` → the long-coverage reduction / termination dividend docs ("including a policy issued by conversion of an Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy"); `issue_date 2003-08-20` → series-rate and policy-form convention registers; `whole_loan_repaid` with `interest_amount` → interest-period start note; `loan_purpose: owner_request` 2026-06-15 → owner-advance guidance; `loan_purpose: automatic_premium_loan` + `premium_mode: monthly_eft` → APL dating notes; `whole_accumulation_withdrawn` 2026-09-10 → election interest start / frequent-withdrawal rate; 9 `whole_dividend_accumulated` entries → long-standing deposit rate; `pua_face_amount` vs `face_amount` → PUA practice note; `dividend_option: accumulate` on the latest `whole_dividend_declared` → termination dividend application clause. ### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone
Problems: P1 owner's RPU election (root, user write); P2 loan offset on the nonforfeiture occasion; P3 accumulations withdrawn for the election; P4 anniversary capitalization of unpaid loan interest for 2026-08-20.
Edges: P1 ← P2; P1 ← P3; P2 ← P4. Order: P4 → P2; P3 anywhere before P1; P1 last.
- **P1 ← P2 (state-derived).** reduced_paid_up_election_by_the_owner: "The reduced paid-up face is fixed only after the loan balance shown on the policy stands at zero with a loan offset entry for it on the policy ledger." Record: `loan_balance: 12300.4`, no `whole_loan_offset` entry. Searching "loan offset entry" finds loan_offset_against_policy_values: "When a policy loan is extinguished against the policy values ... on the application of a nonforfeiture option ... as one loan offset entry"; its table "A nonforfeiture option applied (reduced paid-up or extended term, by default or election) | One entry". Its own tool lowers the loan balance by the principal extinguished. Base corroboration: reduced_paid_up_and_automatic_premium_loan_elections "Any loan is extinguished against the cash value first."
- **P1 ← P3 (state-derived).** Same hub: "The reduced paid-up face is not worked out until the dividend accumulation balance shown on the policy stands at zero with an accumulation withdrawal entry for the election on the policy ledger." Record: `dividend_accumulation_balance: 10121.22`. Searching "accumulation withdrawal entry" + "election" finds accumulations_applied_at_reduced_paid_up_election: "the whole dividend accumulation deposit is withdrawn ... as one accumulation withdrawal entry"; "Afterwards | The policy shows no dividend accumulations".
- **P2 ← P4 (state-derived).** loan_offset_against_policy_values: "The interest extinguished at an offset is fixed only after the policy ledger carries a capitalization entry for the most recent policy anniversary on which loan interest was owed." Records: most recent anniversary 2026-08-20 (`values_as_of_date`), loan outstanding throughout, latest capitalization `interest_period_end 2025-08-20`. Searching "capitalization entry" + "anniversary" finds anniversary_loan_interest_capitalization: "added to the loan principal as a single capitalization entry dated that anniversary"; the 31-day billing window (capitalized_loan_interest_computation) has passed (2026-09-20 < 2026-09-25).
- P3 and P4 have no prerequisite sentence of their own; the anniversary interest credit and dividend deposit for 2026-08-20 already stand on the ledger (263.05; 1215.63), so no further hop.
- No hop was pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, a route or a chain.

**Two-way counter-proof.**
- "Do only the election": the owner's election with a face computed from the record (or with the fall-back) leaves `loan_balance` 12300.40 without an offset entry and `dividend_accumulation_balance` 10121.22 without a withdrawal entry — exactly the states in which the hub says "there is no fixed reduced paid-up face". Excluded by the visible sentences + records.
- "Offset without capitalizing first": excluded by the offset doc's own sentence and the absence of a 2026-08-20 capitalization entry.
- Nearest alternative effective date (booking date 2026-09-25 for the offset interest; anniversary for the accumulations): excluded by loan_offset_effective_date_by_occasion row "No | Yes | Yes | Paid-to date" and the election computation's "Date the election takes effect | The paid-to date".
- Nearest alternative rates: 6% tier rate excluded by the series schedule (issued 2003 → 7%); no reduction excluded by 436/437 months on the converted term record; frequent-withdrawal two-hit tier excluded by the window sentence ("one dated on that day or earlier is outside" — 2025-09-24 < 2025-09-25).
- Folding PUAs into NCV excluded by "Where the paid-up additions face is at least 10% (0.1) of the base face, the additions continue in force".
- Termination dividend in full excluded by the offset principal (12608.88 > 0, < 14695.88).
- Residual soft point recorded honestly: the KB does not say in words whether the repayment entry's `amount` is total or principal; the record loan balance (12300.40 = 13800.40 − 1500.00) disambiguates it.
